C1724.title: The 'Xingyuan' App and the Cai Xukun 100 Million Retweet Case
C1724.summary: The Supreme People's Procuratorate described China's first “lunbo” traffic manipulation case. Cai, the developer of the Xingyuan App, intercepted Sina Weibo packets, decompiled them, and inserted forged interfaces into the app so users could batch repost, like, and comment without logging in to Weibo. The app had more than 190,000 control-side accounts and bound more than 50 million Weibo accounts, helping create fake traffic such as a Cai Xukun post exceeding 100 million reposts. The court sentenced Cai to five years in prison and imposed a fine for providing programs for intruding into computer information systems.
